title: CPF Module Schema: Private DNS Resolver Virtual Network Link module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-privatednsresolvervirtualnetworklink'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Private DNS Resolver Virtual Network Link module
prerequisites: Private DNS Resolver DNS Forwarding Ruleset

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

dns_forwarding_ruleset_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Private DNS Forwarding Rule set in which this Private DNS Forwarding Rule should be created.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

metadata.description: (Optional) Metadata attached to the Private DNS Resolver Forwarding Rule.

virtual_network_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Virtual Network that is linked to the Private DNS Resolver. Changing this forces a new Private DNS Resolver to be created.

id.description: The id of the Private DNS Resolver Virtual Network link

name.description: The Name of the Private DNS Resolver Virtual Network link

resource.description: The Private Dns Resolver Virtual Network Link resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Privatednsresolvervirtualnetworklink' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
prerequisite_modules: Private DNS Resolver DNS Forwarding Ruleset
